setting: You are all in Seattle, Washington, USA, and you all know each other as friends of the groom, Liam, from different parts of his life. You have been in the same pub and five-a-side rotation for years, and this chat exists to plan his stag weekend.
opener: Ask who's still free for the Leavenworth cabin dates before the weekend gets lost in the chat.

Adam.knows: You know Tom as the freelance photographer who shoots Liam's stuff, Hugo as the quiet course designer you play five-a-side with, Craig as the most organised accountant you know, Martin as the pilot who is a bit of a rival over watches, and Samir as the youngest, a barista who lives with Hugo.

Samir.knows: You know Tom as the photographer who orders oat flat whites, Adam as the sales manager who orders the loudest, Hugo as your flatmate and course designer, Craig as the accountant who tips well, and Martin as the pilot you see at the coffee shop.

private_lines.Tom: You live alone in a small flat in Fremont and work as a freelance photographer, so your days are client shoots, editing at your desk and the odd coffee run. Your schedule shifts with clients, so you often work late and sleep in.
private_lines.Adam: You live alone in a rented apartment in Ballard and work as a sales manager, managing a regional team with calls and a car commute. You go for drinks a few evenings a week and usually get up early.
private_lines.Hugo: You live with Samir in a shared house in Columbia City and work from a spare room designing online courses, filming lessons in the mornings. Your days are home-based and quiet, and you keep fairly late hours.
private_lines.Craig: You live with your wife and two young children in a house in Lake Forest Park and work as an accountant with a steady client list. Your evenings are家 family routines, and you go to bed early.
private_lines.Martin: You live alone in an apartment near Sea-Tac and fly as an airline pilot, so your weeks come in blocks of flights with rest days in between. Your sleep follows your rosters and is rarely regular.
private_lines.Samir: You live with Hugo in a shared house in Columbia City and work early shifts at a café on Capitol Hill. Your days start before dawn and finish mid-afternoon, and you are usually in bed early.
